title: Hatching Cosmic Rooster
description: A luminous white and gold rooster emerges from a cracked blue egg in the lower center. A swirling vortex of white, yellow, and purple feathers spirals upward from its head, surrounded by floating golden feathers and glowing particles.
prompt: A glowing white and gold rooster breaking out of a large cracked blue egg, its head transforming into a swirling vortex of white, yellow, and purple feathers that spiral upward, surrounded by floating golden feathers and sparkling particles against a soft pastel background with drips and brushstrokes, ethereal fantasy painting style
